title: Feasibility of Perioperative Continuation Versus Discontinuation of Chronic SGLT2is in Cardiac Surgery
official: Feasibility of Perioperative Continuation Versus Discontinuation of Chronic SGLT2 Inhibitors in Cardiac Surgery: A Multicenter Randomized Trial
summary:
The goal of this multicenter, prospective, randomized (1:1), open-label feasibility pilot trial with blinded endpoint assessment (PROBE design) is to determine the feasibility of perioperative continuation versus guideline-based discontinuation of chronic sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2is) therapy in adults undergoing elective cardiac surgery, while prospectively characterizing metabolic safety.

The main question\[s\] it aims to ascertain are:

* measure successful implementation of the randomized strategy, assessed through prespecified feasibility metric and ascertain postoperative day 7 kidney endpoint. Recruitment rate and reasons for nonadherence will also be reported. No single component is intended as an efficacy endpoint.
* To estimate treatment-group rates of cardiac surgery-associated acute kidney injury (CSA-AKI) and other kidney outcomes and to characterize perioperative metabolic safety, postoperative morbidity, and clinical recovery

Researchers will compare the continuation of SGLT2i group to the discontinuation group to see assess feasibility and safety of continuation of this drug through the perioperative period.

Participants will be asked to either continue or discontinue their own chronically prescribed SGLT2i, at the same approved dose, formulation, route, and schedule through the perioperative period.
conditions: Cardiac Surgery Associated - Acute Kidney Injury
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Chronic treatment with an FDA-approved SGLT2i for ≥ 3 months for an established clinical indication
2. Elective cardiac surgery, including isolated coronary artery bypass graft (CABG), isolated valve surgery, aortic surgery when otherwise eligible, and combined procedures
3. For participants with reproductive potential, pregnancy testing and contraception requirements will follow IRB requirements and the approved labeling of the participant's prescribed SGLT2i.
4. Ability to provide informed consent and comply with study procedures.

   Exclusion Criteria:
5. Prior diabetic/euglycemic ketoacidosis
6. Emergency surgery or surgery required within 24 hours
7. Preoperative shock or ongoing vasoactive support
8. Planned heart transplantation
9. Planned left ventricular assist device (LVAD) or other durable mechanical circulatory support implantation
10. Planned perioperative extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO)
11. Severe renal dysfunction (estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) \<30 mL/min/1.73 m2) or dialysis
12. Pregnancy/breastfeeding
13. Any active ketoacidosis, clinically important preoperative ketonemia/metabolic acidosis
14. Inability to take the chronic medication as assigned
15. Known SGLT2i hypersensitivity
16. Or any condition judged by the investigator to make continuation unsafe or compromise study conduct.
